mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 71 degree temperatures and mainly clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park. The First Quarter moon will be out, and if you stay up until 10:22 PM, you can catch the ISS cruising from the northwest near Cross Plains toward the southeast near Oregon, reaching about halfway up the sky. Expect an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona keeps you informed through various channels, including the VHAT cable channel, the city blog, and a monthly digital newsletter. You can watch council and plan commission meetings live on Spectrum or TDS channel 989 or via the city's YouTube channel.

There is plenty to do today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga sessions, the downtown farmers market, pizza specials, and trivia night. Tomorrow, keep an eye out for concerts at Century School Park and trivia over at Hop Haus Brewing.
In a notable incident from July 13th, the police department responded to a situation where a 36-year-old man was arrested for O-W-I after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.
Today is the perfect day for a Mint Explosion. The store is open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
